commit_message: Complete ADR0126 schema and Event crossing semantics
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR0126 first-release completion on the current-main branch. Timeline persistence is restricted to the six first-release track families; Animation clips persist stable Animation Set + MotionSlotId identity; Transform/Property clips persist validated multi-key typed curves with a shared deterministic sampler; Event and marker payloads are bounded; and Event-track clips compile as exact side-effect points with crossing/scrub-preview semantics.

The PR remains Draft while production runtime composition, Project Rust control, the dedicated Sequencer workspace, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation continue.
